remarks: Enjoy the charm and convenience of this centrally located third-floor, two bedroom unit on the Chautauqua Institution grounds. The unit features a full kitchen, one full bathroom and a combined living and dining area, along with washer and dryer hookups. Recent updates include fresh paint, a new stove, and a new refrigerator, with a new dishwasher to be installed prior to closing. A standout feature is the designated section of the second floor porch offering direct views of the Chautauqua Amphitheater, where you can enjoy the sounds of evening concerts from the comfort of your own space. A wonderful opportunity to own a property in the heart or the Institution and experience all that the summer season has to offer! Delayed negotiations until October 28, 2026 at 12:00 pm.
facts: Dishwasher, Electric Oven, Electric Range, Electric Water Heater, Microwave, Refrigerator
Common Area Maintenance, Common Area Insurance, Maintenance Structure, Reserve Fund
